policy: Expected-result-first mapping: full when the current Playwright test proves the official Zephyr Expected Result through the intended business path; partial when the final expected state or a required path/store element is only partly proven. Test Data notes and operational guidance are supporting instructions, not extra pass criteria unless they are required to reach the Expected Result.

SAM-24962.title: Login Home page
SAM-24962.test: SAM-24962 + SAM-24963 - Login Home and My Account menu
SAM-24962.notes: Current registered-user flow proves successful login and landing on the MX storefront homepage; auxiliary source URL text is not treated as an extra acceptance criterion.

SAM-24963.title: My Account
SAM-24963.test: SAM-24962 + SAM-24963 - Login Home and My Account menu
SAM-24963.notes: The test opens My Account and asserts all eight official menu options. Authoritative PreQA2 execution proved the complete menu and Mi cuenta navigation.

SAM-24964.title: GNB Menu
SAM-24964.notes: Authoritative PreQA2 execution expanded Móviles through the semantic main navigation and navigated via the visible GNB category link to the smartphones BC/category page while remaining on p6-pre-qa2.samsung.com.

SAM-24968.title: Facets/Filter
SAM-24968.notes: A dedicated safe PreQA2 runner selects the real Galaxy Z facet and compares result count plus visible product targets. Runtime evidence is FAIL because the selected facet produced no observable result change; this is implemented automation, not missing coverage.

SAM-24969.title: Add product from BC Page
SAM-24969.notes: Current flow navigates PDP and adds the configured product, but does not prove the official BC-page-origin journey.

SAM-24971.title: Cart page UI
SAM-24971.notes: Current cart flow now covers SKU, item price, product thumbnail, available services, order summary and footer. Official info-icon coverage remains, and the new presentation assertions still need live MX S1 verification.

SAM-24972.title: Increase/decrease/delete the quantity
SAM-24972.test: SAM-24972 - Increase decrease and delete cart quantity
SAM-24972.notes: The dedicated safe test increases quantity, restores it with decrease, deletes the controlled product and confirms the cart is empty; the complete flow passed in MX S1.

SAM-24975.title: Rewards text on cart/checkout/payment
SAM-24975.notes: No current QST test validates Rewards text and tooltip across cart, checkout and payment.

SAM-24981.title: Add SC+ from BC/PDP Page
SAM-24981.notes: Samsung Care+ is added and reflected in cart, but the current route starts from the controlled cart rather than proving the official BC/PDP-origin journey.

SAM-24982.title: Verify trade-up cart page
SAM-24982.notes: Trade-in UI is opened, but the test does not complete the add action and prove the resulting cart/delete state.

SAM-24985.title: Add Extended Warranty on Cart
SAM-24985.notes: No current QST test adds Extended Warranty from cart and proves it on the product.

SAM-24986.title: Cart value on logout
SAM-24986.notes: No current QST test proves cart clearing after registered-user logout and second-account login.

SAM-24988.title: Checkout button on cart page
SAM-24988.test: SAM-24988 - Checkout button on cart page
SAM-24988.notes: Controlled cart clicks Checkout and proves navigation to checkout.

SAM-24989.title: Order Summary on checkout page
SAM-24989.test: SAM-24989 - Order Summary on checkout page
SAM-24989.notes: The checkout flow now verifies SKU plus positive subtotal and total price details and records optional voucher/promo visibility. Keep Partial until the deeper assertions are proven live and any remaining source-supported detail is observed.

SAM-24990.title: Step 1: Contact information
SAM-24990.test: SAM-24989 - Order Summary on checkout page
SAM-24990.notes: Guest flow fills required contact information and successfully advances to Delivery, proving the mandatory Contact Information section is accepted.

SAM-24991.title: Able to add/edit new/saved address
SAM-24991.notes: Current registered flow can enter a new address, but does not prove save visibility plus edit/change of saved/new address as required.

SAM-24992.title: Select saved address
SAM-24992.notes: No current QST test selects a previously saved address and checks out with it.

SAM-24993.title: Save option for reg user
SAM-24993.notes: Current helper does not prove selecting Save and persisting shipping/billing address to Hybris.

SAM-24994.title: Able to checkout with a New address
SAM-24994.test: SAM-24989 - Order Summary on checkout page
SAM-24994.notes: A new shipping address is accepted and payment is reached, but the official Expected Result requires new shipping and billing address behavior.

SAM-24995.title: Save option not visible
SAM-24995.test: SAM-24989 - Order Summary on checkout page
SAM-24995.notes: Guest delivery helper explicitly fails if an address-save option is visible, so successful execution proves the guest Save option is not exposed.

SAM-24999.title: Invalid address
SAM-24999.notes: No current QST test submits invalid address fields and proves validation errors.

SAM-25000.title: Switching delivery modes or saved/new address
SAM-25000.notes: No current QST test switches between delivery modes or saved/new addresses and proves the change.

SAM-25001.title: Back to Top
SAM-25001.notes: No current QST test validates Back to Top positioning behind the cart tooltip.

SAM-25002.title: Payment using credit card with reg user
SAM-25002.notes: Registered Base Store user completes credit-card payment and creates an order. Conditional Clearsale/cron guidance is operational Test Data, not an additional acceptance result when the order completes normally.

SAM-25005.title: Pay in Cash

SAM-25010.title: Track Order
SAM-25010.notes: Existing order creation captures an order code but does not exercise Track Order with email + Order ID.

SAM-25011.title: Backoffice
SAM-25011.notes: Exact order search/open is proven, but the official Expected Result also calls out order/product basic and advanced search.

SAM-25016.title: Sticky checkout button on mobile
SAM-25016.notes: The dedicated mobile Playwright test has passed live in S1 and proves the sticky cart checkout control plus navigation to checkout. Coverage remains Partial because it does not prove sticky behavior on the checkout page itself.

SAM-25020.notes: No current EPP QST test validates PLP facets/filtering.

SAM-25022.title: Cart page UI
SAM-25022.notes: Core cart assertions exist in Base Store, but this EPP case is not executed in EPP and not all official cart UI elements are asserted.

SAM-25034.title: Step 1: Contact information
SAM-25034.test: SAM-24989 - Order Summary on checkout page
SAM-25034.notes: Mandatory contact information is proven in Base Store, but this official case is for the EPP branch and is not yet executed there.

SAM-25045.title: Payment using credit card with reg user
